main.description: Restores a dismissed application to the active queue. This is an AppView-local change and is never written to the community's repo.

community.description: The community the application belongs to.

subject.description: The applicant whose application to restore.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the approval.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: ApplicationNotFound
errors.description: No pending application exists for the subject in this community.
